msgstr: MAIS NOUS LES\nAVONS RETENUS\nLOIN DE NOUS'

msgid:
STAY CLOSE
TO THE WALL.
RUN AROUND
ONE LAP.

THOSE WHO
INHERIT OUR
WILL, SHINE
IN THE MIDDLE.
